sources.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
sources.title: U.S. Attorney Announces Federal Charges Against 47 Defendants in $250 Million Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
sources.notes: Updated 2025-02-06. First public charging wave: 47 defendants; six indictments + three informations; case numbers 22-CR-223, 22-CR-124, 22-CR-224, 22-CR-226, 22-CR-222, 22-CR-225. Alleged ~$250 million scheme. CHARGED_ALLEGED at date of release. Do not treat $250 million as proven_loss.

sources.issuing_body: U.S. Attorney’s Office, District of Minnesota
sources.title: U.S. Attorney Announces Federal Charges Against 10 Additional Defendants in $250 Million Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
sources.notes: Second major charging wave: 10 additional defendants. USAO-MN URLs often return Akamai interstitial. Release itself does not state running total 60; journalism 60 is LEAD_UNVERIFIED.

sources.title: Seventy-third defendant charged in Feeding Our Future Case
sources.notes: Hussein Mohamed Farah (New Vision Foundation) charged by information with one count of wire fraud; 73rd defendant. New Vision received approximately $2.7 million Feb 2021–Jan 2022. CHARGED_ALLEGED. Amount is amount_paid as alleged.

sources.title: 75th defendant charged in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Muna Wais Fidhin charged in 10-count indictment; 75th defendant. ~300,000 meals claimed; ~$1 million claimed; ~$27,000 kickbacks. CHARGED_ALLEGED. Notes Aimee Bock already convicted at trial and pending sentencing.

sources.issuing_body: IRS Criminal Investigation (USAO-MN announcement by U.S. Attorney Daniel N. Rosen)
sources.title: 77th defendant charged in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Ousman Camara, nine-count indictment; 77th defendant. Corresponding USAO-MN slug Akamai-blocked: https://www.justice.gov/usao-mn/pr/77th-defendant-charged-feeding-our-future-fraud-scheme. CHARGED_ALLEGED.

sources.title: Feeding Our Future defendant sentenced to 10 years in prison
sources.notes: Abdimajid Mohamed Nur sentenced by Judge Nancy E. Brasel to 120 months + 3 years SR; restitution $47,920,514. ADJUDICATED (fraud sentence/restitution). Juror-bribery case separate and then pending before Judge Doty.

sources.title: In landmark sentence, Feeding Our Future scheme leader sentenced to 28 years in prison
sources.notes: Abdiaziz Shafii Farah sentenced to 28 years + 3 years SR; IRS-CI text (quoted in search index / IRS Pub 3583) states restitution $47,920,514. Live fetch returned historical-content stub. Confirm full page text if IRS archive is restored. ADJUDICATED (fraud sentence).

sources.title: Fourth defendant pleads guilty to scheme to bribe Feeding Our Future juror
sources.notes: Abdiaziz Farah pleaded guilty 2025-06-17 before Judge David S. Doty to one count of bribery of a juror. $120,000 cash delivered to Juror 52 on 2024-06-02. ADJUDICATED as to plea; sentencing then pending.

sources.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
sources.title: Minneapolis Man Sentenced for Scheme to Bribe Feeding Our Future Juror
sources.notes: Abdulkarim Shafii Farah, 25, sentenced by Judge Eric C. Tostrud to 57 months + 1 year SR. Not the July 2026 120-month sentence. IRS republication of same announcement exists. ADJUDICATED.

sources.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
sources.title: Five More Plead Guilty in Minnesota Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
sources.notes: Official conviction count 63 as of this date. U.S. v. Mohamed et al., 24-cr-15. Group alleged to have stolen/laundered $14.6 million. ADJUDICATED (pleas).

sources.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
sources.title: Two More Defendants Plead Guilty in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
sources.notes: Official conviction count 65. Press Release Number 26-340. Suleman Yusuf Mohamed agreed restitution $8,662,287; Gandi Yusuf Mohamed ~$1.3 million; Abdullahe Nur Jesow sentenced 43 months, restitution $866,458. ADJUDICATED. Last verified official conviction count in this corpus.

sources.issuing_body: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
sources.title: Feeding Our Future Ringleader Sentenced to 500 Months
sources.notes: Aimee Bock sentenced 500 months. >$240 million fraudulently obtained and disbursed is DOJ post-trial characterization, not a court-certified net-loss finding in this PR. IRS republication dated same day. ADJUDICATED.

sources.title: Minneapolis man sentenced to 43 months for role in feeding our future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Abdullahe Nur Jesow: charged Sept 2022; pleaded guilty 2025-09-18 to one count money laundering; sentenced 43 months + 2 years SR; restitution $866,458. ADJUDICATED.

sources.title: Fifty-sixth defendant pleads guilty in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Official conviction/plea count 56 as of Jesow plea. U.S. v. Hassan et al., 22-cr-224; S&S Catering group alleged $17.4 million. Same day as Housing Stabilization first-wave charges. ADJUDICATED.

sources.title: Guhaad Hashi Said pleads guilty to his involvement in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Page not fully dated in fetch; USAO described 52nd defendant. Pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and conspiracy to commit money laundering. ADJUDICATED.

sources.title: Woman bound for Dubai arrested at airport and indicted in Feeding Our Future scheme
sources.notes: Approximate date ~2025-05 (71st defendant; detention hearing May 30). Hibo Daar; two counts wire fraud. CHARGED_ALLEGED.

sources.title: Kenyan national charged with international money laundering in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Approximate date ~2025-08 (after Abdiaziz Farah 28-year sentence). Ahmednaji Maalim Aftin Sheikh, 74th defendant. CHARGED_ALLEGED.

sources.title: Man surrenders for role in Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
sources.notes: Date in source is year 2026 (after Najmo Ahmed plea 2025-02-24; Ahmed sentencing set 2026-06-15). Said Abdullahi Ereg surrendered; indicted 2024-06-24. CHARGED_ALLEGED (Ereg); ADJUDICATED (Ahmed plea).

sources.title: Minneapolis woman sentenced to 51 months in prison for role in feeding our future $250 million fraud scheme
sources.notes: Sahra Mohamed Nur; pleaded 2023-09-07; sentenced 51 months + 2 years SR; restitution $5,000,240. S&S Catering. ADJUDICATED. Exact sentencing-PR calendar date not captured in SOURCES.md.

sources.title: Third / Fifth juror-bribery defendant plea releases
sources.notes: Two URLs: this canonical plus https://www.irs.gov/compliance/criminal-investigation/fifth-juror-bribery-defendant-pleads-guilty-to-scheme-to-bribe-feeding-our-future-juror. Dates 2025 (Abdulkarim Farah plea; Said Farah plea). Five defendants charged in juror-bribery case; all five had pleaded as of Said Farah’s plea. $200,000 cash gathered; $120,000 delivered. ADJUDICATED (pleas).

sources.title: IRS-CI Publication 3583 (Rev. 3-2026) — FY2025 annual report excerpt on Feeding Our Future
sources.notes: Month-level date 2026-03 recorded as 2026-03-01. Agency recap: Abdiaziz Farah 28 years and $47.92 million restitution; at least 75 charged; Mukhtar Mohamed Shariff 210 months and almost $50 million restitution; Sharon Denise Ross 43 months and $2.4 million restitution. Scheme described as over $300 million. AGENCY_POSITION; scheme-size figure is not a court net-loss finding.
